description: Return up to five labeled address suggestions or resolve one opaque selection. Read-only: this never changes a request or records consent. Query and selection are mutually exclusive. Suggestions are candidates only; never guess or auto-select. Manual entry is always available. If Google output is shown to the customer, include the exact attribution text Google Maps.

locale.description: The customer's language: fr for French, en for English. Suggestions come back in it.

query.description: What the customer typed. Pass query or selection, not both.

selection.description: The suggestion the customer picked. Pass query or selection, not both.

session.description: The session returned by your previous lookup with a query, to keep the same search as the customer types more. Leave it out on the first query.

name: lookup_service_address
title: Look up a service address
